IS 516 : Part 11 : 2020 Hardened Concrete-Methods of Test - Part 11 Determination of Portland Cement Content of Hardened Hydraulic Cement Concrete
ICS 91.100.30
CED 02
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard (Part 11) specifies the procedures for determination of Portland cement content of a sample of hardened hydraulic cement concrete. The test method is applicable only for concrete made with ordinary Portland cement.
2 REFERENCES
The standard listed below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standard indicated below:
IS No.
Title
4032 : 1985 Method of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement ( first revision )
